title: green pytest gate

The v0.7.2 cut had to ship with an honest-debt disclosure (64 failures) because the suite has pre-existing failures. This PRD eliminates them. All fixes are test-side unless noted; no production behavior changes.

every AC is a one-line shell command with explicit expected output
